name: H+
source:
The title H+ is rather self-explanatory to those who understand the meaning of the letter "H" to the Japanese (pronounced "ecchi", it basically refers to all things sexual). The game consists of three unrelated stories, all of which can be played directly from the main menu:

〜愛と青春の××〜

1. The first story is a rather mundane tale of a boy and a girl who meet outside and head to the girl's apartment; thanks to the hero's irresistible charm (with a bit of help from alcoholic beverages), the two are able to engage in a variety of sexual acts.

〜ＡＶ ｒｏａｄ〜

2. The protagonist of the second story is an aspiring journalist, who is given the task to interview a famous female movie star. The interview begins with taking pictures of the celebrity wearing different costumes, and ends with her removing those costumes and performing activities which turn into a blockbuster porn movie.

〜Ｍｙ Ｌｉｔｔｌｅ Ｇｉｒｌ〜

3. The third story is dedicated to the obligatory "little girl", a female high-school student. There are two possible scenarios, both involving seduction of the poor girl: one involves a sexy female teacher, the other an older male schoolmate.

[Modified from [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/h]Moby Games[/url]]
translation:
对理解日语字母“H”含义的人而言，《H+》这个标题可谓不言自明：其读音为“エッチ”，基本泛指一切与性有关的事物。游戏由三个互不相关、均可从主菜单直接进入的故事组成：

《爱与青春的××》

1.第一篇是一个颇为平淡的故事：一对男女在外相遇，随后前往女孩的住处。凭借男主角无可抗拒的魅力——以及酒精的一点帮助——两人得以尝试各种各样的性行为。

《AV之路》

2.第二篇的主角是一名立志成为记者的年轻人，任务是采访一位著名女影星。采访从拍摄女星身穿不同服装的照片开始，最终却变成女星脱下这些衣服、进行各种表演，拍出一部大卖色情片。

《我的小女孩》

3.第三篇献给此类作品中不可或缺的“小女孩”——一名女高中生。剧情有两条路线，都会令这个可怜女孩遭到诱惑：一条涉及性感女教师，另一条则涉及年长的男同学。

[据[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/pc98/h]Moby Games[/url]修改]
